title: Apply to be a surveyor's assistant
summary: Find out how to apply to become a surveyor's assistant by applying to the Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (BOSSI).
intro:
A surveyor’s assistant carries out survey work under the supervision of a registered surveyor. The registered surveyor takes responsibility for their assistant's work.

To become a surveyor’s assistant, you'll need to apply to the Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (BOSSI).

Before you apply, check BOSSI’s requirements for becoming a surveyor’s assistant.

You must pay an annual fee to maintain your status as a surveyor’s assistant.
who_can_apply: Hold a technical qualification in surveying and have 3 years of practical experience.
Have at least 10 years of practical experience in surveying acceptable to BOSSI.
One of the listed criteria must apply to you.
what_you_need: A MyServiceNSW Account or your OneGov account.
Your supervisor’s full name, contact details, and registration number.
Copies of the following documents (must be certified, in English, and in PDF format, maximum file size 4MB):
A passport quality photo in JPG format.
A credit or debit card for the enrolment fee.

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account, or log in using your OneGov credentials.
Follow the prompts to apply to be a surveyor's assistant.

faqs.a: A surveyor’s assistant carries out survey work under the supervision of a registered surveyor, who takes responsibility for their work.

faqs.q: What is required to become a surveyor's assistant?
faqs.a: You must apply to the Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (BOSSI) and pay an annual fee to maintain your status.

faqs.q: Where can I check the requirements for becoming a surveyor's assistant?
faqs.a: You should check BOSSI’s requirements for becoming a surveyor’s assistant.
